product_context: CitySocial is a modular-monolith social platform for city residents (currently Austin), built as one Rails app whose features live as near-independent modules (mountable engines) under components/. platform_core owns identity (User), the Follow social graph, a public Graph API, and an event bus; feed is the reference module (posts + timeline); communities is subreddit-style (join, post, comment, up/down vote); marketplace is classified listings with photos; restaurants is head-to-head Elo ranking of local spots. Users are residents who follow each other and engage through these modules. 'Better' means tightening the existing engagement loops (do -> others see it -> they get notified/react), filling in missing empty/loading/error and accessibility states on views that already ship, and polishing the UX of already-shipped modules. It does NOT mean speculative net-new features nobody asked for. Every view must compose the PlatformCore::Ui components and Tailwind v4 design tokens (no hand-rolled markup, no hardcoded hex). Modules may depend only on platform_core and must cross boundaries only via events or a sibling's app/public API (Packwerk enforces this).
out_of_scope: Anything touching auth, authorization, sessions, or payments
Standing up a whole new module (that is the human-run /new-app-module flow)
Cross-module references that violate the Packwerk boundary contract
Editing the @theme design tokens or the standalone Tailwind build config

items.title: Feedback 'Support' toggle emits aria-pressed
items.problem: The feedback 'Support' button is a toggle whose supported/unsupported state is conveyed only by color and label swap, so assistive-tech users get no pressed-state signal.
items.evidence: components/feedback/app/views/feedback/submissions/_submission.html.erb:4-9 and show.html.erb:41 — support ButtonComponent switches variant on `supported` but never set pressed:. ButtonComponent accepts pressed: (F-004, PR #13).
acceptance: Support button renders aria-pressed reflecting support state on list and show
Existing variant swap and supports_count unchanged
Request spec covers aria-pressed

items.title: Add a post composer to the feed
items.problem: The feed exposes a create action and POST /feed/posts route but ships no composer UI, so residents cannot post to their city feed from the app.
items.evidence: components/feed/config/routes.rb:2 exposes POST /feed/posts and components/feed/app/controllers/feed/posts_controller.rb:9 implements create (reads params[:body]), but components/feed/app/views/feed/posts/index.html.erb had no composer form and nothing links to it.
items.northstar_fit: Directly builds the core do->others-see->notified loop: posting is the primary 'do' action and Feed::Post already emits feed.post_created (fanned to followers by Notifications); the loop was broken only because the UI had no way to post.
acceptance: Feed index renders a PlatformCore::Ui composer (text area + submit) posting to the feed create action
Non-blank body creates a Feed::Post by the current user, redirects, and the post appears
Blank body does not 500: re-renders with an inline error and creates no post
Posting still publishes feed.post_created
Request specs cover rendering, round-trip, event publish, and blank rejection
items.notes: 1b proposal, grounded in a shipped dead-end (create action + route with no composer view). Built this run; full bin/verify green (225 examples). IDs start at F-034 because the codex/claude tracks already reserve F-025..F-033 via open PRs.

items.title: Add Top sorting to community comments
items.problem: Community conversations can only show comments chronologically even though comment vote scores are already stored, so the most useful responses stay buried.
items.evidence: research.md#R-001; components/communities/app/models/communities/comment.rb defines only chronological while its Votable concern maintains score.
acceptance: Communities::Comment gets a top scope ordering by score desc, created_at desc
Post page offers New and Top sorting, New default
Sorting does not alter vote casting
Model and request specs cover both orders

items.title: Let sellers renew stale marketplace listings
items.problem: Marketplace sellers must recreate a stale listing to restore visibility even though the existing timestamps and expiration already support a safe renewal flow.
items.evidence: research.md#R-004; components/marketplace/app/models/marketplace/listing.rb already owns expiration and recent ordering, and mark_sold provides the owner-action pattern.
acceptance: Owner-only renew resurfaces the listing and extends expiration 30 days
Blocked for sold and within 48h of creation or renewal
Owner actions show Renew only when eligible
Model and request specs cover timestamps, ownership, sold state, cooldown

items.title: Notify feedback authors when status changes
items.problem: Users who submit product feedback must manually re-check the board to learn whether their idea or issue moved to a new status.
items.evidence: research.md#R-007; Feedback::Submission already publishes feedback.submission_status_changed with submission, author, and status primitives, but Notifications has no direct-recipient delivery path and subscribes only to follower activity.
acceptance: Notifications asynchronously subscribes to feedback.submission_status_changed and targets only the submission author
Each new status updates the existing per-submission notification and resurfaces it unread
Retried delivery of the same status does not re-alert an already-read notification
Submission creation creates no status notification
Service, event-wiring, and request specs cover delivery and inbox rendering

items.title: Surface unread direct messages in the global nav
items.problem: Residents get no ambient signal that a neighbor has messaged them: the messaging inbox unread count lived only on the /messaging screen, and messaging appeared as a redundant browse pill rather than a personal inbox like Notifications.
items.evidence: app/views/layouts/application.html.erb rendered a Notifications button+badge via Notifications::Inbox.unread_count_for but no messaging equivalent, despite Messaging::Inbox.unread_count (components/messaging/app/public/messaging/inbox.rb) already existing; PlatformCore::Modules CATALOG listed messaging nav:true (browse pill) unlike notifications nav:false. Corroborated by fresh research brief R-006 (grader 10/10).
acceptance: Session area shows a Messages button with an unread-count badge mirroring Notifications, gated on Modules.enabled?('messaging')
Badge reads Messaging::Inbox.unread_count and is omitted at zero
Messaging moves out of the browse-pill row so it is not duplicated
Request specs cover badge present/absent and module-disabled hiding
items.notes: Grounded in master repo state (existing Notifications badge pattern + existing Messaging::Inbox.unread_count public API + messaging being a personal inbox mislabeled as a browse pill). Independently corroborated by research brief R-006 (10/10), which is fresh only on PR #25's branch, not master, so it was NOT consumed from research.md; grounded directly in repo evidence via the 1b dead-end/unsurfaced-API veins.

items.title: Give the global nav search input an accessible label
items.problem: The global navigation search field has only a placeholder and its icon is decorative, so it is unlabeled for screen readers on every page (WCAG 4.1.2).
items.evidence: app/views/layouts/application.html.erb:50 renders f.text_field :q with only a placeholder and no <label>/aria-label; the adjacent magnifying-glass SVG at :48 is decorative (pointer-events-none) with no aria-hidden.
items.northstar_fit: Accessibility is baseline product quality; an unlabeled sitewide search barrier keeps assistive-tech residents from the primary find-things affordance.
acceptance: The nav search input exposes an accessible name via aria-label (or an associated visually-hidden label)
The decorative search SVG is marked aria-hidden="true"
Rendered layout and search behavior are otherwise unchanged
A request/layout spec asserts the accessible name is present
items.notes: 1b proposal, grounded a11y fix on every page. Small (effort 1).

items.title: Vote control reflects the current user's own vote
items.problem: The up/down vote buttons look identical whether or not the current user has already voted, so casting a vote gives no visual confirmation.
items.evidence: components/communities/app/models/communities/votable.rb:24 — vote_value_for returns -1/0/1 but _vote.html.erb renders both arrows the same.
acceptance: Upvoted renders active up arrow; downvoted active down arrow
Anonymous/un-voted render neutral
Applies on list, show, comments
Spec asserts active state for the voter

items.title: Add an empty state to the restaurants admin index
items.problem: The restaurants admin index renders a header-only table when there are no restaurants, the only collection index in these modules lacking a zero-state.
items.evidence: components/restaurants/app/views/restaurants/admin/restaurants/index.html.erb:39-40 renders TableComponent and iterates @restaurants with no `if @restaurants.any?` guard and no EmptyStateComponent.
items.northstar_fit: weak: admin-only polish; keeps the design-system zero-state convention consistent so the tool stays legible, but it is not a resident-facing engagement loop.
acceptance: With zero restaurants the admin index renders an EmptyStateComponent (optionally with an add-restaurant action)
When restaurants exist the ranked admin table renders as before
A request spec covers the zero-case
items.notes: 1b proposal. The one collection index still missing the standard EmptyState guard.

items.title: Give marketplace gallery images distinguishing alt text
items.problem: On a marketplace listing with multiple photos, the main image and every thumbnail share the identical alt of the listing title, so a gallery announces the same name for every image.
items.evidence: components/marketplace/app/views/marketplace/listings/show.html.erb:9 and :15 set alt: @listing.title on the main photo and on every thumbnail in the photos.drop(1).each loop.
items.northstar_fit: Accessibility baseline: distinguishing alt text lets assistive-tech residents tell a listing's photos apart, supporting the marketplace browse/decide loop.
acceptance: Gallery thumbnails carry indexed/distinguishing alt text (e.g. 'Title photo 2 of N'), not a repeated identical title
The main image keeps a meaningful alt
Rendered gallery markup is otherwise unchanged
A request spec asserts distinct alt values across gallery images
items.notes: 1b proposal, grounded a11y fix on the listing detail gallery.

items.title: Batch-load notification actors to remove the inbox N+1
items.problem: The notifications inbox resolved each row's actor with a separate PlatformCore::Graph.user query, an N+1 scaling with inbox size.
items.evidence: components/notifications/.../index.html.erb:22 called notification.actor per row; Graph exposed only single user(id).
acceptance: PlatformCore::Graph.users(ids) returns id=>user hash (avatars preloaded) in one query
Inbox resolves actors via one batch
Rendered avatars/handles unchanged
Graph + request specs assert flat query count

items.title: Give icon-only vote buttons accessible labels
items.problem: The upvote/downvote controls are icon-only glyphs with no accessible name.
items.evidence: components/communities/app/views/communities/posts/_vote.html.erb:4,8 — up/down glyphs with no aria-label
acceptance: ButtonComponent accepts optional aria_label:
Vote buttons expose aria-label Upvote/Downvote

items.title: Add empty state to the restaurants leaderboard
items.problem: The restaurants leaderboard rendered a bare, header-only table when there were no restaurants.
items.evidence: components/restaurants/app/views/restaurants/leaderboard/index.html.erb:9 — TableComponent iterated @restaurants with no any? guard.
acceptance: With no restaurants renders an EmptyState
When restaurants exist the ranked table renders as before

items.title: Share public events through a reusable capability
items.problem: Residents who discover a CitySocial event have no reliable way to send its canonical page into the chats where local plans already happen.
items.evidence: Research PR #28, R-009 (grader 10/10); components/events/app/views/events/events/show.html.erb already groups public ticket and calendar actions, while shared UI lives under components/platform_core/app/public/platform_core/ui/.
acceptance: A public PlatformCore::Ui::ShareComponent accepts a title and canonical URL, composes shared buttons, and always renders a Copy link action
A Stimulus controller reveals a separate native Share action only when navigator.share is supported and keeps copy fallback usable after cancel, permission, or API failures
Accessible live status reports copy/share success or failure
Event detail shares event_url(@event), never the external ticket/source URL, while ticket and calendar actions remain unchanged
The design catalog plus component and request specs document and cover the capability without adding a dependency
items.notes: Capability lane: shared canonical copy/native sharing with Events as the first public consumer. R-009 remains on open research-only PR #28, so this run did not edit that concurrent branch. F-021 is reserved by open PR #26. Verification incomplete only because PostgreSQL and screenshot tooling were environment-blocked.

items.title: Add select support to FormFieldComponent
items.problem: Dropdowns were hand-rolled label+select markup, bypassing the design system and showing no inline validation errors.
items.evidence: form_field_component.rb:6 INPUT_TYPES excludes select; marketplace/listings/_form.html.erb and communities/new.html.erb hand-roll f.select.
acceptance: type: :select with a collection renders a styled select
Validation error shows inline error + border-danger
type: :select without a collection raises ArgumentError
Marketplace + new-community forms use it
/design documents select

items.title: External ticket/detail links open in a new tab
items.problem: The events 'Tickets & details' CTA navigated away in the same tab, losing the user's place.
items.evidence: components/events/app/views/events/events/show.html.erb:32 — external @event.url button had no target/rel.
acceptance: External ticket links open in a new tab with rel=noopener noreferrer
Internal links unchanged
Spec asserts target/rel

items.title: Filter the restaurant leaderboard by cuisine
items.problem: Residents cannot narrow restaurant rankings to comparable cuisines even though every restaurant already stores cuisine.
items.evidence: research.md#R-002; leaderboard_controller.rb accepts no filter while cuisine is populated and displayed.
acceptance: Leaderboard accepts a cuisine query param via a by_cuisine scope
FormFieldComponent select lists catalog cuisines
No selection preserves the full leaderboard
Request spec proves narrowing

items.title: Add event calendar actions
items.problem: Residents who discover an event cannot carry it into their calendar.
items.evidence: research.md#R-003; events show page has ticket details but no calendar action despite complete start/end/venue/description.
acceptance: Event detail adds a Google Calendar link from existing fields
Read-only action downloads a valid ICS with a fallback end time
Ticket behavior unchanged
Request specs cover both formats and the fallback

items.title: Create public resident profiles with avatars
items.problem: Residents have no public identity surface beyond a handle.
items.evidence: Explicit human priority: public user profile with avatar; fields stay optional and never expose email or hidden PII.
acceptance: Resident edits only their own optional display name, neighborhood, bio, avatar
Avatar accepts JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 5 MB with inline errors
Anyone views /people/:handle with public fields and follow counts, never email/auth
AvatarComponent + author links make profiles discoverable
PII-safe Graph.public_profile + platform_core.profile_updated
Model/request/public-API/component specs cover the flow

items.title: Create a follower activity notifications inbox
items.problem: Residents have no durable way to learn when people they follow publish activity across CitySocial.
items.evidence: docs/roadmap.md Next promises a notifications module subscribing to feed.post_created and communities.post_created; events and Graph.follower_ids exist.
acceptance: Generated Notifications engine owns an additive, reversible schema, depends only on platform_core
Post events async-create one idempotent notification per follower, never actor/non-followers
Signed-in residents have an inbox with unread count, empty state, read-through, mark-all-read
Residents read only their own; destinations restricted to internal paths
Model/delivery/event/public-API/request specs cover the flow

items.title: Create private resident messaging
items.problem: Residents have no private place to coordinate a meetup, marketplace handoff, or follow-up.
items.evidence: docs/roadmap.md Next promises a messaging module; public resident profiles provide the safe entry point.
acceptance: Generated Messaging engine owns an additive one-to-one schema, depends only on platform_core
Resident starts a conversation from a profile/handle and sends an initial message
Participants view one thread, reply, see unread in an owner-scoped inbox; non-participants cannot
Unknown/self recipients and blank/oversized messages render inline errors
messaging.message_created publishes IDs but never content
Model/public-API/request/route/event/boundary checks cover the flow

items.title: Batch-load feedback board authors via Graph.users
items.problem: The product feedback board resolves each row's author with Graph.user and calls it twice per row, issuing two user queries per submission on an unbounded list.
items.evidence: components/feedback/app/views/feedback/submissions/_submission.html.erb:30 calls submission.author twice; F-018 added Graph.users for the batch.
acceptance: Board resolves authors via Graph.users so query count stays flat
Each row calls the author lookup at most once
Rendered handles unchanged
Request spec asserts flat author query count
items.notes: Below the 1.0 schedule threshold; depends on F-018's Graph.users batch. Grounded but low-value.

items.title: Add messaging inbox management
items.problem: As conversation history grows, residents need a way to find active threads and clear inactive ones.
items.evidence: F-013 messaging milestone 1 caps the inbox at 50 recent conversations and ships no archive or search.
acceptance: Participant archives/restores a conversation only for their own inbox
Inbox search matches the other participant's handle or display name without exposing private fields
Archived conversations remain readable and return on a new reply

items.title: Batch-load the messaging conversations inbox
items.problem: The messaging inbox issues three per-row queries for each of up to 50 conversations - other participant, last message, unread count - an N+1 scaling with inbox size.
items.evidence: components/messaging/app/views/messaging/conversations/index.html.erb:15-17 calls other_participant / messages.last / unread_count_for per row; conversations_controller.rb:7 loads .limit(50).
acceptance: Inbox resolves participants via Graph.users and last-message + unread counts via grouped queries so query count stays flat
Rendered participant, preview, and unread counts unchanged
Request spec asserts flat query count as conversations grow
items.notes: Effort 3 (three distinct batch sources); split into participant-batch vs message/unread-batch if it doesn't fit one run. Depends on F-018's Graph.users. Below threshold.

items.title: Carry public context into new conversations
items.problem: A message started from a listing or community post can lose the public context that prompted the resident to reach out.
items.evidence: F-013 establishes a profile/handle conversation entry point but intentionally stores no sibling record references or context links.
acceptance: Messaging accepts a validated internal context path and short public context label when a conversation starts
The thread header links back to that context without reading a sibling model
Marketplace and communities can pass context through URL parameters without adding module dependencies
items.notes: Product lane milestone 3: Marketplace listings and community posts now open a context-preserving private compose flow; Messaging stores only a validated internal path and public label, then renders the backlink without reading sibling models.

items.title: Launch reliable pickup game rosters
items.problem: Austin residents cannot tell whether a casual game has a real spot, enough committed players, or a fair next-in-line process before traveling to play.
items.evidence: research.md#R-008; Events is read-only discovery and Communities owns discussion, while neither owns resident-hosted rosters, capacity, or deterministic waitlist promotion.
acceptance: A generated PickupSports engine owns additive game and roster data, depends only on platform_core, and is mounted as its own product
A signed-in resident can host and edit a future game with sport, skill, time, neighborhood, venue, details, and capacity while the host takes the first spot
Anyone can browse and filter upcoming games and view a public roster with open, full, waitlisted, and canceled states
Residents can join or leave; overflow is waitlisted and the earliest waitlisted resident is promoted transactionally when a player leaves
The module publishes primitive game, roster, and promotion events and exposes a read-only UpcomingGames public API
Model, request, public API, route, and boundary checks cover ownership, validation, duplicate joins, capacity, FIFO promotion, cancellation, and filters
items.notes: Product lane milestone 1. Persona: Austin newcomer or casual player. Job: know a suitable game has a real spot and viable roster before traveling. Loop: host posts -> residents discover and join -> capacity/waitlist changes are visible and promotion events are notification-ready -> residents commit or leave early. Follow-ups: attendance closeout, recurring games, Notifications delivery, and reliability signals.

items.title: Batch-load the viewer's votes on the community post list
items.problem: Rendering the community post list calls vote_value_for(current_user.id) once per post/comment, issuing one communities_votes lookup per row.
items.evidence: components/communities/app/views/communities/communities/show.html.erb:30 and posts/show.html.erb:11,56 — each vote_value_for runs a separate SELECT inside the loop (introduced with F-004).
acceptance: Viewer's votes for a page load in a single query passed into the vote partial
Rendered vote highlighting unchanged from F-004
Spec asserts vote query count does not grow with rows
items.notes: Below the 1.0 schedule threshold; grounded but low-value (one indexed lookup per row).

items.title: Semantic <time> timestamps with exact-date tooltips
items.problem: Relative timestamps render as plain text with no machine-readable datetime and no hover-to-see-exact-date.
items.evidence: feed/posts/index.html.erb:10, communities/communities/show.html.erb:38, communities/posts/show.html.erb:14,52, marketplace/listings/show.html.erb:45 — 'X ago' rendered as bare text, no <time datetime title>.
acceptance: Relative timestamps wrap a <time datetime=...> element with a title showing the exact date/time
Rendered text unchanged
Spec on at least one surface
items.notes: Effort 3 (three distinct batch sources); split into participant-batch vs message/unread-batch if it doesn't fit one run. Depends on F-018's Graph.users. Below threshold.
